title: Game components 1.0
description: The physical components of a game as printed: every kind of component and each different piece once, with how many there are. Extraction only: no rules modelling, no interpretation.

component_kinds.description: One entry per kind of component (a card type, a token type, a board). Declares the fields its pieces carry.

fields.description: Every field the pieces of this kind carry in `fields`. Missing when the kind has none.

description.description: Where on the piece the value is printed and what exactly it records.

back.description: What the back of this kind looks like, when known.

components.description: Each different piece once. Pieces that are identical in everything recorded here are one entry with their number in `count`.

count.description: How many of this piece the game has.

title.description: Printed name, spelled exactly as printed, typos included.

fields.description: Values for the kind's declared fields; null where the value is not printed or not known. Missing when the kind has no fields.

text.description: Other printed text, verbatim, lines joined with ' / '.

back.description: Only when this piece's back differs from its kind's back.
